title: Activate DSAI3V Async Assurance as live background-assurance and conditional-materialisation control flow

proposed_delta.effect: Required GitHub Actions assurance runs asynchronously relative to lawful development construction. Running required assurance no longer creates a foreground development stop. Exact terminal assurance signals update durable AssuranceFutures and wake the existing DSAI_VIT_PHYSICAL_CONTROLLER for re-evaluation of a pre-existing ConditionalMaterialisationIntent.
proposed_delta.materialisation_rule: All required assurance remains mandatory. Before any serialized squash materialisation the existing controller must re-evaluate exact RequiredAssuranceSet PASS, owner authority, programme-state/current-pointer consistency, QA/review/blockers, current GRT/currentness, exact predecessor/train placement, security, SIQ READY and exclusive lease. Post-write exact-tree equality and canonical completion/DEVOBS receipts remain mandatory.
proposed_delta.successor_rule: Lawful successor construction may continue under existing dependency frontier, PacketPredecessorRequirement and BuildAheadBudget rules while predecessor assurance is running. Speculative irreversible external side effects remain forbidden until authoritative prerequisite satisfaction and their own authority.

Never force-push or rewrite history.
